statement: Let T be a Scheme with [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace T], let ℓ : ℕ with [Fact ℓ.Prime], let M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ), and let S : Scheme.Stratification T. Assume that for every a : Fin S.n there are E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ) and M_E : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (S.domain a)) Ab.{u + 1}) ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (S.immersion a)).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E)) with IsLocallyFinitelyPresented of that module and a Nonempty isomorphism after scalar extension to the corresponding pullback of M. For every D : TopologicalSpace.Closeds T, assume that for every D' < D, every Y' and closed immersion i' : Y' ⟶ T with range contained in D', there are a finite coefficient field E' and a constructible module P' on Y' whose scalar extension is isomorphic to the pullback of M along i'. Then, for every Y and closed immersion i : Y ⟶ T with [IsClosedImmersion i], [Nonempty Y], and Set.range i ⊆ D, there exist U, j : U ⟶ Y, Z, and k : Z ⟶ Y, with j an open immersion and k a closed immersion, whose ranges are disjoint and have union Set.univ, together with finite coefficient fields EU and EZ and module objects PU and PZ on U and Z. PU and PZ are constructible over their respective finite coefficient rings, and their scalar extensions are respectively isomorphic to (CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) (j ≫ i)).obj M and (CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) (k ≫ i)).obj M. This is exactly the complete Lean signature of exists_nonempty_support_open_closed_models.

proof.text: Obtain a nonempty open j:U -> Y carrying a constructible finite model by choosing an interior of a pulled-back stratum and transporting its model.

Take the scheme-theoretic closed complement k:Z -> Y and its strict closed support D' < D. Apply the supplied induction hypothesis to k followed by i. Combine its finite model with the open-piece model and the complementary-range identities.
